article.title: Celebrate by Turning the Blowout into Durable Power
article.author: Max Elbaum
article.content: The anti-MAGA majority turned out and showed its muscle on November 3. Every demographic group voted less Republican than in 2024, with the biggest shifts coming from Latinos and young voters. The anti-fascist electoral alliance of Left and center (mostly) held. Both progressives and mainstream Democrats increased their strength. MAGA took a drubbing at every level of government—federal… Source
